title: Multiplication Galaxy
summary: A silk-print star chart where children 7-10 read planet orbit arrays as multiplication facts and lock stable orbits by answering them.
mobileSupportNote: Full learning loop works at 390x844 (verified live): stacked stage with sticky instrument dock, tap + full keyboard answer path. On dense systems (>=90 satellites, e.g. 12x12) the satellite dots get small, so cumulative ring tally labels (12 · 24 · ... · 144) carry the count on every viewport.

cover.alt: Staged real moment: the 4 x 6 = ? fact in Quartet Cluster just answered — orbit locked (mineral rings, registration ticks), skip-count total 24 showing, four paper answer dials with 24 confirmed, 'Orbit locked. 4 x 6 is 24.' feedback

desktop.alt: Honest desktop landing: the star chart with eleven table constellations (2-12) along the dotted survey path, each with its miniature orbit system and n/6 progress

tablet.alt: Hero tablet view of a mission: 2 x 6 = ? fact headline over the drifting orbit array, instrument column with four paper answer-node dials, count-by-rings and rebuild controls
